facts.basis: total public debt outstanding (Treasury's Debt to the Penny, via PrimeRates): $37,637,553,494,935.61 on 2025-09-30 and $40,096,954,633,566.68 on 2026-09-29 (the final reading published before the fiscal year ended); Δ = $2,459,401,138,631.07 ≈ $2.46 trillion in 364 days
facts.rate: Δ ÷ (364 × 86,400 s = 31,449,600 s) = $78,201.35 a second ≈ $78,000 (2 significant figures, the write-up's one rounding); × 60 = $4,692,080.93 ≈ $4.7 million a minute
facts.pay: median full-time pay $1,251 a week (BLS Q2 2026) × 52 = $65,052 a year; × 40 = $2,602,080 ≈ $2.6 million, a working life with no raises
facts.duel: 1 minute ($4,692,081) ÷ 40 years of median pay ($2,602,080) = 1.80: 1 minute is bigger (md only); the counter passes $2,602,080 at 33.274 s ≈ 33 seconds and stops on it exactly
facts.flip_point: 1 minute ÷ 40 = $117,302 ≈ $117,000 a year: anyone earning more has a 40-year pay bigger than 1 minute
facts.public_part: of the $2.46 trillion, $2.09 trillion is held by the public (PrimeRates): $2.09T ÷ 31,449,600 s = $66,455.54 ≈ $66,000 a second; × 60 = $3,987,332 ≈ $4.0 million a minute, still more than 40 years of median pay
facts.assumptions: the 364-day growth spread evenly (the debt grows in steps, so this is the average rate); gross federal debt, including intragovernmental holdings; no 'fiscal 2026' claim, because the 2026-09-30 reading could not be confirmed
facts.verdict: 40 years of median pay: ≈ 33 seconds. / 1 minute of new US debt ≈ $4.7 million.

youtube.title_pick: Which Is Bigger: 40 Years of Your Pay or 1 Minute of New US Debt?
youtube.description:
Which is bigger: 40 years of your pay or 1 minute of new US debt? 1 minute of new US debt is about $4.7 million. 40 years of median pay ($2,602,080) goes by in about 33 seconds.

The math, shown:
• Treasury's Debt to the Penny: $37.638 trillion on Sept. 30, 2025; $40.097 trillion on Sept. 29, 2026.
• That's ≈ $2.46 trillion more in 364 days.
• ÷ (364 × 86,400 seconds) ≈ $78,000 a second, ≈ $4.7 million a minute, ≈ 72 years of median pay.
• 40 years of median pay: $1,251 a week × 52 × 40 = $2,602,080. At ≈ $78,000 a second: ≈ 33 seconds.
• Earn more than ≈ $117,000 a year? Your 40 years beat 1 minute.
• Yours: yearly pay × 40 ÷ 78,000 = your working life in seconds.

Follow for the math behind your money — shown, not hand-waved. @envelopemath

Animation and original sound: The Back of the Envelope. Debt: U.S. Treasury, Debt to the Penny (total public debt outstanding), the readings of Sept. 30, 2025 and Sept. 29, 2026 (the final reading before the fiscal year ended), via PrimeRates. The growth is spread evenly over those 364 days; the debt grows in steps, so this is the average rate. It is gross federal debt, including debt the government owes itself. Pay: BLS median usual weekly earnings of full-time wage and salary workers, Q2 2026, × 52; a working life is 40 years of it, with no raises. Not financial advice.
#NationalDebt #DebtClock #MoneyMath
